# pangolin_client_role (Resource)

Assigns a role to a machine client, so it gets the private resource access granted to that role. Clients tied to a user can't be assigned roles; they inherit their user's. Requires Pangolin 1.25 or later, Enterprise Edition. There is no update: changing either ID replaces the assignment. Import using the format `<client_id>:<role_id>`, e.g. `terraform import pangolin_client_role.example 5:2`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_client_role" "ci_runner" {
  client_id = 5
  role_id   = pangolin_role.example.role_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `client_id` (Number) Machine client ID.
- `role_id` (Number) Role ID to assign.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_client_role.example 5:2
```
